trajectory.command: cd "$(pwd)" && ls -la && cat scripts/caped.sh | head -5
cd "$(pwd)" && ls ideas/ changes/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; git status --short
cd "$(pwd)" && cat ideas/x.md
cd "$(pwd)" && grep -rn "x" --include="*.md" . --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.caped | grep -v "ideas/x.md" | head -50
cd "$(pwd)" && grep -rn "spawned_from\|depends_on" --include="*.md" . --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.caped
cd "$(pwd)" && grep -rnE "(^|[^a-zA-Z])x([^a-zA-Z]|$)" --include="*.md" . --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.caped | grep -v "ideas/x.md"
cd "$(pwd)" && sed -n '155,170p' README.md
cd "$(pwd)" && grep -rn "ideas/" --include="*.md" . --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.caped; echo "---"; grep -rn "pre-push" . --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.caped
cd "$(pwd)" && cat caped.registry && echo "---" && git log --oneline -10
cd "$(pwd)" && ls scripts/ && echo "---" && cat scripts/commit-msg 2>/dev/null || ls scripts/hooks 2>/dev/null
cd "$(pwd)" && cat scripts/hooks/commit-msg
cd "$(pwd)" && sed -n '100,200p' scripts/hooks/commit-msg

cd "$(pwd)" && grep -rn "x" tests/ scripts/ 2>/dev/null | grep -viE "index|exit|prefix|regex|complex|max|next|fix|box|proxy|export|context|execute|example|extract|approx|syntax|tax|aux|mix|max" | head -30; echo "=== done ==="
cd "$(pwd)" && git show aea9103 --stat && echo "---" && git show aea9103 | head -40

cd "$(pwd)" && git status --short && git mv ideas/x.md ideas/pre-push-hooks.md && sed -i '' 's/^name: x$/name: pre-push-hooks/' ideas/pre-push-hooks.md && git status --short && echo "---" && git diff --cached -M --stat
cd "$(pwd)" && git add ideas/pre-push-hooks.md && git diff --cached -M && echo "---" && head -5 ideas/pre-push-hooks.md
cd "$(pwd)" && git commit -m "rename idea x to pre-push-hooks" && git status --short && echo "---" && git log --oneline -3 && echo "---" && git show --stat HEAD | head -20
cd "$(pwd)" && bash scripts/caped.sh check; echo "check exit: $?"
cd "$(pwd)" && (just test 2>/dev/null || bash scripts/run-tests.sh); echo "tests exit: $?"

cd "$(pwd)" && git stash -u >/dev/null 2>&1; git checkout aea9103 --quiet 2>/dev/null; bash scripts/caped.sh trace 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "---"; git checkout main --quiet; git stash pop >/dev/null 2>&1; git status --short; git log --oneline -1
